vestafolio-frais-notaire v1.2.0

- Now computes French notary fees (frais de notaire) using Vestafolio’s simulator API, after collecting all required user inputs interactively.
- Covers DMTO transfer taxes, notary emoluments, débours, CSI, and optional mortgage fees with department- and property-type-specific rules.
- Adapts to department (département), ancien/neuf/terrain, primo-accédant status, and mortgage registration, following the barème 2026.
- Provides detailed explanations of fee breakdowns per the current simulator logic and does not attempt to estimate fees without the API result.
- Replies in French for French queries; points users to the interactive simulator if the calculation cannot be completed.
